title: William M NDE 4269
content: I was driving on the Queen Elizabeth Way from Buffalo to Welland, Ontario, after being very tired from working a 40 hour day job and 4 or 5 music projects. I frequently drive between Toronto and Buffalo. I was taking my girlfriend to her parents' home in Welland and went to sleep at the wheel. I became aware that we were out of our bodies and quickly flying up toward space, holding hands. We flew straight up for a minute or so when we started to see a park or countryside-like landscape. It seemed to be twilight, dark, but we could see trees, bushes, etc. Suddenly, four creatures intercepted us. They seemed about ten feet in height and were invisible, but we could see a vague humanoid outline (my best description would be like the invisibility effect in the movie 'Predator', which I saw some years later). Two flanked each of us and began to gently separate us. They overwhelmed us with a feeling of the highest love and compassion that was well beyond anything we could experience on Earth - a divine love. We therefore had no resistance to their effort. I recall feeling sort of like a baby in mother's arms, but it's hard to accurately describe. Two of them moved her upward toward the distant landscape, and two moved me back downward. I felt so much love, peace and comfort that I wanted to protest and say 'No, please let me stay here', but I heard inwardly (without ears or psychically) that I could not stay. Next, I could see my car, in flames, from maybe about a quarter of a mile up above. I felt a sensation of falling and awakened in the car. The front was on fire. I moved her from leaning on me, as she was when I fell asleep, knowing that her body was an empty shell. I had left her above with those beings. In shock, I made a few failed attempts to get out of the car, not knowing why my feet couldn't be lifted. They were through the floor. After waking and passing out a few times I saw someone approaching the car. The man (a passing trucker) saw the flames as he passed and turned back to see if someone was inside. He was startled by my appearance, told me not to worry, and that he would get help. I recall being removed from the car by firemen. The fire was now on the dashboard. I regained and lost consciousness many times between the crash site, the hospital in Welland and then the hospital in the U.S. A couple of weeks later I was in intensive care, and overwhelmed with grief and guilt at having lost a person their life. She came in through my window as a classic 'woman in white' apparition, and again I heard without physically hearing that I shouldn't blame myself and that everything was as it should be. This has been very difficult for me to write. It still makes me cry. She then floated out of the door into the hallway, right between two nurses who obviously didn't see her. I am still amazed by it all.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Overwhelmed by "the highest love and compassion"; felt like "a baby in mother's arms."

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Rapid upward flight "toward space" rather than a tunnel/void.

arrival.other_being_detail: Four ~10-foot-tall creatures, "invisible" with a "vague humanoid outline" (compared to the 'Predator' invisibility effect).

environment.environment_other_detail: A "park or countryside-like landscape" at "twilight"; could see "trees, bushes, etc."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell asleep at the wheel while driving; car crash and fire.

person_demographics.occupation: Worked a 40-hour day job and multiple music projects.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with upward flight to a twilight landscape; intercepted by four beings; separation from girlfriend; told inwardly he could not stay; then observed burning car from above and returned with a falling sensation.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Four tall, invisible humanoid-outline beings (compared to 'Predator' invisibility) gently separating the experiencer and his girlfriend; later, a 'woman in white' apparition of the girlfriend visiting ICU and passing between nurses unnoticed.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "out of our bodies and quickly flying up toward space, holding hands"; "the highest love and compassion"; "No, please let me stay here"; "I could not stay"; "my car, in flames, from maybe about a quarter of a mile up above"; "woman in white"; "everything was as it should be."
